basis.note: cost is dominated by output tokens: input is cache-creation only and two orders of magnitude smaller

projection.reading: the action budget is NOT the binding constraint: reaching 120 actions would take about $35 of desk time, so the run will stop on cost_ceiling at roughly 29-61 actions. That gap is the measurement, not a shortfall -- E3 asks for the bill shape, and this is its predicted shape stated before the money is spent.

spend_gate.detail: proxy/spend_gate.py does not exist on this commit. S3-spend-gate is the item that creates it and it has not landed: branch agent/s3-spend-gate carries no file under proxy/ matching *spend*. Until it does, this run budgets against its own arithmetic only and CANNOT see what a concurrent session has spent against the same key and the same bill -- which is precisely the exposure S3 was raised to close (INC-BA-003).
